subject: Mobile Development
title: Touchscreens Replace Buttons
description: A fast breakdown of Touchscreens Replace Buttons for builders.

hook.text: Before 2007, every phone had physical buttons. Most had tiny screens and big keypads.

buildup.text: The iPhone replaced all buttons with a single multi-touch glass screen.

discovery.text: Pinch to zoom, swipe to scroll, tap to select — touch gestures felt natural from day one.

twist.text: BlackBerry fans insisted physical keyboards were superior. They held on for years.

climax.text: Within five years, virtually every new phone was a touchscreen. Buttons vanished.

punchline.text: Glass killed every button except the power key.

quiz.question: What did the iPhone replace physical buttons with?
